lines.text: CPU marching cubes with 3D noise — the working cave/blob generator
lines.note: The field it shows before any surface is a 32-cubed lattice sampled about a metre apart, and its cutoff of 0.5 is reachable from no map token: the room that opens the movable line has fixed it.

note_src.quote: a token naming noise_scale or iso_level still changes nothing

lines.text: Interactive display of the 15 unique marching cubes cases (from 256 total)
GPU cave system — noise-driven marching cubes producing walkable cave geometry
lines.note: The table exhausts every corner configuration and nothing else: the cave beside it runs six octaves of ridged noise into a lattice sampling at 4.69 m, so four of those scales never reach a triangle.

note_src.quote: octaves — HOW MANY SCALES OF ROCK SURVIVE THE LATTICE. The ridged loop runs a fixed six times.

lines.text: GPU torus sculpture — marching cubes extracting torus isosurface
lines.note: The hole topology calls the torus's invariant is nowhere in the field: it is an offset on the number you compare against, and moving that number by 35 closes genus one to genus zero, no term touched.

note_src.quote: GENUS 1 BECOMES GENUS 0 over most of the ring, with no change to a single term of the field.

lines.text: GPU compute gyroid minimal surface — domain-warped
Gallery of multiple marching cubes shapes — sphere
GyroidDemo
lines.note: A minimal surface has no thickness and cannot be seen, so this one is given a body made of noise — a threshold varying through space — and what ships is 2,859 separate solids with no period readable.

note_src.quote: 2,859 separate bodies, no period readable anywhere in the box.

lines.text: GPU compute fountain shape — vertical form generated by marching cubes
lines.note: Water needs something that travels; the fountain has nothing that moves — its surface is re-extracted every frame, so what reads as falling water is a run of unrelated solids, motion borrowed from recomputation.

note_src.quote: geometry flowing like water because it *is* recomputation, not motion; nothing travels, everything is re-decided

lines.text: GPU SDF sculpting — add spherical blobs with smooth union

pearls.edge: The chamber hands you the cutoff as a tool, and the only move your hand has is setting a whole block on one cell: the movable line arrives quantised to the grid its fields were meant to dissolve.

edge_src.quote: place a block on the catalyst_target — and where you place it, the field crosses its threshold, air becoming stone

lines.text: GPU flat terrain — marching cubes landscape with gentle noise
lines.note: The turn from graph to level set costs one literal, and the shipped 0.4 spends it thinly: fifty of 4,225 columns have an inside, so the heightmap era ends across 1.18% of the floor.

note_src.quote: The whole difference between a plot and a level set is that one literal.

lines.note: A threshold on noise yields no doorway — an arch must be written in as its own masked term — and this map's one token resolves to the overhang scene: the portal it is named for stands next door.

lines.text: GPU terrain with portal arches — landscape-scale marching cubes with embedded portal …
lines.note: The room asks who set the iso-value, and its own passages do not answer: the doorway is max(terrainDensity, -portalsDensity), seven torus fields placed by hand — a threshold argument standing on geometry no threshold found.

the difference between geology and architecture is just parameter choice
marchingcave
lines.note: The room insists no designer placed these corridors; its hero sets use_fallback = true, so the shader never loads and what you walk is a hand-written 200-metre sine tunnel.

note_src.quote: MarchingCubes.glsl is never loaded, and what renders is _create_simple_cave_mesh()'s hand-written 200 m sine tunnel below.

lines.text: marchingcubes_cave
Animated noise field explorer — watch marching cubes extract surfaces from evolving noise in …
lines.note: Nothing here extracts the moving surface: the explorer only marks which cells straddle the iso-level and fills each with a solid cube, so what breathes on screen is the scaffold marching cubes consumes and discards.

note_src.quote: What it draws is therefore NOT the surface. It is the set of cells in which the field changes its mind

Full marching cubes metaball system — proper isosurface extraction from metaball field
a surface does not need vertices to exist — a function plus a threshold is already a shape
a single organism is what a crowd looks like when the field between bodies is dense enough
lines.note: The map's whole claim is that bodies merge and come apart; its hero displaces a fixed sphere by the field instead of extracting one, so the genus is pinned at zero and nothing in it can ever open.

note_src.quote: The genus is PINNED AT 0 by the proxy: this surface can never split, never merge and never open a hole, whatever the field does.
